fix: even if they take in the particular actions and speeches only in outline
reason: ὁλοσχερῶς (broadly, cursorily) contrasts with κατὰ μέρος; no 'gladly', no 'in detail'. Current English inverts the sense.

fix: this seems to me the finest and boldest of all his achievements [...]
reason: Greek ends with ***; the lacuna has to be marked.

fix: since very soon the general, with his forces [...]
reason: Chapter seam, not a lacuna: πρὸς αὐτὸν συνάψοντος opens ch. 7, so 'join him' is duplicated here. τοῦ στρατηγοῦ means 'the general' (Hasdrubal).

fix: they should, without any delay, put even this hope to the test
reason: ὑπερβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι means to postpone; μηδεμίαν ὑπερβολήν means 'without delay', not 'no extreme measure'.
ἐπίστασις (pause, taking stock) is fairly rendered by 'recover his wits'. 'Make a stand' is less accurate.
